notes: Explore days on the Public Service and Safety cluster: on the cluster map the student places its 5 sub-clusters (Emergency Response, Judicial Systems, Local, State and Federal Services, Military and National Security, Public Safety) and fills job cards for three jobs at different training levels, such as a city clerk (on-the-job route), a park ranger (two-year or four-year study) and a firefighter (academy training), comparing pay, training time, hours and conditions, and noting one worker from a group seldom shown in the field, disabled workers among them across the year. Every figure carries its source and year, and the data sheet says to check the figures this school year. First-look sub-cluster: Local, State and Federal Services, because local, state and federal services are the jobs behind the public budget grade 8 social studies reads, and the sub-cluster avoids opening the course on force, trauma or recruiting (g8-sub-public-service-government-services). The cluster's study ends with a plan line the cluster changed; the frame groups the clusters into units (STANDARD.md section 3). Limit: a survey with one field task, not every sub-cluster at depth; Pathways gives the breadth. Teacher note: the military is shown as one real route with its costs and returns, neither promoted nor condemned, with no recruiter material on a student page; the school's own policy governs recruiter visits. No task asks about a record or anyone's legal status. Teacher note: any section on this cluster that touches Behavioral and Mental Health, Emergency Response, Judicial Systems or Public Safety carries health's "if a student tells you something" steps on its teacher page; a school may swap such a section for another sub-cluster of the same cluster. Hands on to g10-clu-public-service (the cluster's field tasks and data sheet at higher demand) and to the Pathways rows for its other sub-clusters (g10-sub-public-service-emergency-response, g10-sub-public-service-judicial, g10-sub-public-service-military, g10-sub-public-service-public-safety), each of which assumes this row. Grade 9 is skipped because no career education course owns there.
